newsitem.title: SPAIN: SOCCER-NEWCASTLE CHAIRMAN TO MEET TOSHACK, SPANISH TV SAYS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-NEWCASTLE CHAIRMAN TO MEET TOSHACK, SPANISH TV SAYS.

text.p: Deportivo Coruna coach John Toshack will meet Newcastle chairman Sir John Hall in Marbella later on Thursday to discuss the vacant manager's job at the English club, Spanish state television reported.
The Welshman is among several men being linked to the job at St James's Park in the wake of Kevin Keegan's shock resignation on Wednesday.
Toshack said earlier this week he would not continue at Deportivo after his contract expires at the end of the season.
Hall has been on holiday in Spain over the New Year.
